_comment: PRICING ONLY. This is the tuition data the site falls back to when Sanity is not configured or unreachable. When Sanity is connected, the Tuition & Pricing document in the Studio overrides everything here. Program names, age ranges, and photos are NOT editable content — they live in src/lib/site.ts.

notes.earlyDropOff: For the school day program, early drop-offs before 8:30 AM may be arranged with the school for an additional fee.
notes.annualDiscount: Paying annually represents a 5% discount off monthly tuition.
notes.siblingDiscount: 10% discount applied to the tuition of the child with the lower rate.
notes.proration: Tuition is not prorated. Monthly rates already account for school closing days.
notes.registrationFees: A one-time application fee, a one-time family fee, and a refundable security deposit are due at registration. Amounts are not published in the handbook — contact the school.
